notes.title: Version 0.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
* Updated teams to match season 25/26 (2 new teams: Barnet & Oldham)
+ Enabled Steam cloud saves
* Minor adjustments to team ratings & kits
* Fixed issue allowing negative scores in contract negotiation
* Fixed resolution selector listing the same resolution multiple times
* Fixed issue with balance text not updating after buying gloves
- Removed ugly Unity splash screen

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
* Improved in-game performance when it is night
* UI bug fixes.
* Updated certain kit colors to be more accurate.

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello. Thank you all for the valuable feedback you have provided to Goalkeeper Journey. This is a small patch made to address some of the difficulty concerns some players have had.

The full patch notes are as follows:
+ Added new difficulty option: "Easy".
+ Added new "Team Scoring" option. This will make the player's team randomly score goals between scenarios.
* Difficulties have been adjusted.
* Improved in-game performance.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First of all, a big thanks to everybody who has played the game so far. This update is a small patch that addresses a few bugs that have been discovered. 

The full patch notes are as follows:
* UI Improvements.
* Clubs are now slightly more willing to renegotiate your contract.
* "Normal" difficulty is now slightly easier. 
* "Hard" and "Legendary" difficulties are now slightly harder.
* Fixed bug creating a never-ending scenario.
* Fixed never-ending penalty shootouts.
